name: Bulgaria

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of white, green and red.
flag.symbolism: White stands for peace, green for the land and agriculture, and red for the courage and blood of the people.

hook: Bulgaria starts with white on top, then green, then red; Hungary uses the same colours but starts with red.
trivia: The tricolour was first adopted in 1879 after liberation from Ottoman rule; the communist-era emblem was removed in 1990.
Bulgaria replaced the lev with the euro on 1 January 2026.
